executiveSummary.headline: Convert Broad Scenario Coverage Into Clearer Buyer Consideration
executiveSummary.lead: Bethesda Marriott appears across 71.4% of eligible scenarios and ranks first among four Bonvoy peers, yet consideration is only 30.1%. That gap is not proof of a website defect: it is a measurement signal to investigate. The hotel already has strong meetings, NIH access, dining, and fitness assets; the priority is to make its most defensible demand signals unmistakable and internally consistent.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared; Certified Peer Position compares only the certified four-hotel set. Presence does not equal bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: The Consideration Gap Is a Signal, Not a Diagnosed Cause
themes.what: The hotel appears broadly but is mentioned in fewer than one-third of comparable consideration answers despite substantial amenities and demand anchors.
themes.whyItMatters: This supports a focused visibility investigation, not a claim that the website caused the result. Official content already verifies NIH, Walter Reed, American University, metro shuttle, dining, and Peloton/TRX fitness.

themes.title: Meetings Inventory Is Strong but Needs One Capacity Language
themes.what: Marriott lists 18,719 square feet, 27 event rooms, and Grand Ballroom capacity of 450, while marketing also uses approximately 19,000 square feet and seating up to 560.
themes.whyItMatters: Rounding or setup style may explain the difference. Sales should qualify each figure and align overview, events, and planner materials rather than framing it as a crisis.

themes.title: NIH Access Is a Defensible Competitive Differentiator
themes.what: NIH lists Bethesda Marriott on its shuttle route with complimentary service directly to the Clinical Center; Hyatt emphasizes Metro adjacency and approximately 20,000 square feet of meetings.
themes.whyItMatters: A planner brief can distinguish NIH shuttle access, breakout depth, and Pooks Hill location without criticizing Hyatt or claiming why ADP displacement occurred.

priorities.action: Commercial team: strengthen NIH, government, and corporate signals
Sales and Marriott content: reconcile meeting figures within 30 days
Sales strategy: build a sourced Hyatt planner brief
Leadership: decide whether association content supports target demand

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: Official pages and priority partner listings clearly present approved NIH/government/corporate demand signals; meeting figures are setup-qualified; and sales has a sourced, non-adversarial Hyatt comparison.
executiveSummary.closing: Bethesda Marriott’s first-place peer rank should not obscure 30.1% consideration. Its best route forward is to organize verified strengths—direct NIH shuttle access, deep breakout inventory, Pooks Hill positioning, dining, and fitness—into clearer buyer signals, while treating any visibility lift as something to measure later rather than promise now.

methodology.scope: Combines the certified ADP baseline with a bounded review of named public pages and zero-cost technical probes. No paid research, Airtable write, ADP remeasurement, or customer publication was performed.
claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — a directly observed, source-backed discrepancy.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — evidence warrants review but does not prove a defect or cause.
REQUIRES_HOTEL_CONFIRMATION — hotel leadership must establish the source of truth before correction.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership confirms facts, priorities, and public changes.
Digital or brand teams implement only approved corrections and document verification.
Dealality packages measurement context and evidence without implying booking or revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked in a later review. Completing an action does not itself prove a change in AI presence, bookings, or revenue.
methodology.nextStep: Confirm the decision items, then authorize the highest-priority validated work.
